FAQ

Are these panels suitable for Saudi Arabia?

They may suit hot-climate wall projects when the selected assembly meets the project’s thermal, fire, structural and weather-resistance requirements. Final suitability must be verified for the building and location.

What information is needed for a Saudi Arabia quotation?

Send the city, building use and height, wall dimensions or drawings, selected model codes, required documents, quantity and delivery destination.

Can I request finish samples?

Yes. Shortlist several texture codes and share the project type and delivery city so the sample request can be discussed.
